lf-margin-entry-gallery.description: The developer gallery's exhibit of page-edge action controls, disclosure controls, and status indicators across every rank, tone, face, agent workflow stage, reader interaction state, and compact-to-Page-Map projection. It renders canonical controls through the runtime's margin-entry helpers; its live specimens change only local exhibit state and record no gestures. Use it only in the feature gallery; ordinary pages demonstrate these states through the live widgets that own them.
